capabilities: Pull single Confluence pages by URL, page ID, or title
Recursively pull page trees into folder hierarchies
Re-pull changed pages with version tracking
Convert Confluence macros to Markdown, callouts, and wikilinks
Download page attachments and map metadata to frontmatter
disambiguation: Read-only: it pulls pages from Confluence into the vault but never writes changes back to Confluence.
extras: Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Limited to Confluence Server/Data Center (REST API v1) with PAT auth, not Confluence Cloud; desktop only, Obsidian 1.5.0+. Includes a Skip SSL verification option for self-signed certificates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch Confluence Server pages and convert their macros, links and attachments into Markdown notes.
summary: Confluence importer that pulls Confluence Server pages into a vault as Markdown files, with attachments, frontmatter and version-based re-sync.
